### David's Throne Endures
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/davids-throne-endures
Passage: Jeremiah 52:31-32
Points:
- Jeremiah concludes not with Jerusalem's ruin, but with the pardon and elevation of King Jehoiachin in Babylon.
- After decades of imprisonment, Jehoiachin was freed and given a higher seat than all the other captive kings.
- Jehoiachin's release was a visible sign that God had not abandoned His covenant promises to David's line.
- Even when circumstances appear bleak and signs of hope seem faint, God remains faithful to His people.
- The ultimate fulfillment and guarantee of God's Davidic promise rests in the resurrected Jesus Christ.
